summary: Fit 52-year-old with CT-confirmed uncomplicated diverticulitis: observe — no routine antibiotics and outpatient management.

inputs.hpi: Two days of constant left iliac fossa pain with mild nausea; eating and drinking. Otherwise fit, no immunosuppression. Non-smoker.

exam.abdomen: Tender left iliac fossa with mild localised guarding; no peritonism, no mass.

imaging.name: CT abdomen/pelvis
imaging.result: Uncomplicated sigmoid diverticulitis (modified Hinchey Ia): pericolic fat stranding; no abscess, no free gas, no free fluid.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Acute uncomplicated diverticulitis
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: CT-confirmed uncomplicated sigmoid diverticulitis, tolerating oral intake.

match: re:observe rather than antibiotics: observation without antibiotics
re:observe rather than hospital admission: outpatient management

guideline.name: WSES guidelines — acute colonic diverticulitis (2020 update)
guideline.section: Uncomplicated diverticulitis: antibiotics and outpatient management
guideline.citation: Sartelli M et al. World J Emerg Surg 2020;15:32.

guideline.name: DIABOLO trial
guideline.citation: Daniels L et al. Br J Surg 2017;104:52-61.

rationale: DIABOLO and AVOD showed no benefit of antibiotics in CT-proven uncomplicated diverticulitis in immunocompetent patients; WSES 2020 supports outpatient management without routine antibiotics.
